defective_pattern: Partitioning unidimensional scales into ad-hoc item parcels when composite total scores are mandated.
why_defective: Ad-hoc parceling violates the structural integrity of unidimensional scales and ignores the composite total score mandate.
observed_symptoms: Creation of arbitrary parcels for unidimensional scales
Ignoring composite total score mandates in SEM
Lack of synchronization with atomic micro-stage synthesis
corrective_remedy: When composite total scores are mandated for unidimensional constructs (e.g., SCI_T, PA_Negative, BSSI_T), specify them in R lavaan as single-indicator latent variables with factor loading fixed to 1.0 and measurement error variance fixed to Var(y) * (1 - alpha) per PRN-20260923-3A3A2B. Must be synchronized with LSN-2026-ATOMIC-MICRO-STAGE-TRIAD-SYNTHESIS.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect ad-hoc parceling terms in syntax for unidimensional scales
